The *Buddhaaviheṭhakapañha* ("The Buddha’s Kindness", Mil 5.5.5) is a dilemmatic question included in the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. The text concerns the non-harming nature and benevolence of the Buddha, with SuttaCentral recording cross-references or thematic parallels to the *Lakkhaṇa Sutta* of the *Dīgha Nikāya* (DN 30, PTS DN iii 142) and two narrative Jātakas: the *Seyyajātaka* (Ja 310) and the *Lomasakassapajātaka* (Ja 433) [SuttaCentral]. Three modern translations across three languages are indexed for this entry on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
